reason: I already get my bread and labneh at the dekkene most days, and on Saturday I drive to Jbeil for the big shop anyway. Paying $2 a bag to a stranger on top of the till price, when I cannot see the till myself, is not worth it for me.
objection: How do I know they really paid the cheap price and didn't add a markup? I only have their word for what was at the till.
would_change_my_mind: A photo of the till receipt in the bag with every order, and a first bag with no fee so I can check it against Spinneys prices myself.
